summary: Add one strict exact-label local reader for company-specific RFI and Submittal fields and ground the same requested label, workflow identity and complete value in model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate adaptable questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Different company forms use labels such as RFI Manager, Category, Submittal Type and Procurement Package that should not require one new dedicated implementation each
Exact label matching against the existing immutable evidence and workflow index improves adaptability without semantic inference or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: The local shortcut requires a strict English question using the literal word field, one exact RFI or Submittal and a one-through-six-word label no longer than 60 characters.
Known semantic fields retain dedicated contracts; general prose, synonyms, Email-prefixed labels, headers, quoted history, signatures and unlabeled values remain outside this path.
More than 32 primary files or candidate passages and conflicting explicit values fail closed.
The implementation does not infer label equivalence, meaning, applicability, role, authority or relationships to other fields.
